title: Membership in the encoded index set
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on pairs of natural numbers, and let $n,i\in\mathbb{N}$. The string formed by pairing $n$ copies of the bit $1$ with the binary bit string of $i$ belongs to the set of all strings that encode some pair $(r,s)$ satisfying $p(r,s)$ if and only if $p(n,i)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate on pairs of natural numbers
